definitions.explanation: The person or side that wins a competition, battle, or contest. Used in sports, games, elections, and figurative contexts.

examples.japanese: {勝者|しょうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
{勝者|しょうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧トロフィー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{贈|おく}られる→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: A trophy will be presented to the winner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{常|つね}→常：28958_tsune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{勝者|しょうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{視点|してん}→視点：03187_shiten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}かれる→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is often said that history is always written from the winner's perspective.

notes:
{勝者|しょうしゃ} means the winner or victor — the person or side that prevails in a competition, battle, or contest.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勝者|しょうしゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{敗者|はいしゃ}→敗者：12941_haisha⟧: winner and loser
- ⟦{最終的|さいしゅうてき}→最終的：13013_saishuuteki⟧な{勝者|しょうしゃ}: ultimate winner
- {勝者|しょうしゃ}なき⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧: a battle with no winner
- {勝者|しょうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to determine the winner

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{優勝者|ゆうしょうしゃ}→優勝者：21822_yuushousha⟧: champion (specifically of a tournament or competition)
- {勝|か}ち{組|ぐみ}: winners (as a group, often figurative — those who succeed in life)
- ⟦{敗者|はいしゃ}→敗者：12941_haisha⟧: loser, defeated party (antonym)

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal. In casual speech, ⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (the person who won) or ⟦{勝|か}ち→勝ち：02540_kachi⟧ (winning/victory) is more natural.
